This is the Apache-2.0 `sha3-circuit` source from
`alexandroszacharakis8/sha3-circuit` commit
`1a3ef7d2ce603a26081f428fa74b4a631e243f25`.

The package version is changed from 0.1.0 to 0.1.1. Ledger9 also resolves
the published 0.1.0 package for its legacy 0.7 proof stack. The distinct
version lets Nix vendor both sources without a name collision. No Rust source
files were changed.
